## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can JJ Mahal hold?
JJ Mahal seats 350 guests in its fully air-conditioned hall.

### Where is JJ Mahal?
440/5, GST Road (NH32), opp. LKS Gold House, Tambaram West, Kadaperi, Chennai 600 045 (Near Tambaram bus stand and railway station).

### What facilities does JJ Mahal have?
Fully centralised A/C, Acoustic hall, Valet parking, Power backup, Full CCTV, Fire safety, Photography & décor on request, Catering for events, Complimentary changing rooms, Security staff.

### What functions suit JJ Mahal?
Pre-wedding functions, seminars, social events, birthdays, anniversary parties and community gatherings.

### Is décor available?
Yes. Décor is handled by the team at the venue, and photography is available on request.

### How do I check if JJ Mahal is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 89404 67737.
